name: tr_walter
caption:
IF WALTER HAD A POKÉMON TEAM, HERE'S WHO WE'D SEND OUT 🎮🏀

🧸 Teddiursa: a little bear always licking honey off its paws. Big 12 Freshman of the Year at Baylor
🐟 Feebas: so shabby-looking it's largely ignored. Pick 19, hurt before camp, sent down to the 905
❄️ Glaceon: drops its body temperature at will. Game-winning three with 0.5 seconds left in Orlando
🎯 Inteleon: its ability is Sniper, it finds a foe's weak points. 40.9% from three last season
🔥 Infernape: its fire never goes out. Playoff career-high 24 in an overtime win over Cleveland
🌊 Milotic: what Feebas evolves into, the most beautiful Pokémon of all. Fully evolved, 11.0 points a night through 10 games

That's a party we'd take into any building. Which one would you swap in? 👇

Monster sprites: PMD Sprite Collab (sprites.pmdcollab.org), CC BY-NC 4.0

beats.vo: If Ja'Kobe Walter had a Pokemon team, here's what we'd be running.
beats.dlg: IF WALTER HAD A TEAM|OF MONSTERS...

beats.vo: First up, Teddiursa. A little bear that's always licking honey off its paws. At Baylor, Big Twelve Freshman of the Year.
beats.dlg: LICKS HONEY OFF ITS PAWS.|BIG 12 FRESHMAN OF YEAR!

beats.vo: Feebas. Because of its shabby look, it's largely ignored. We took him nineteenth. He got hurt before camp and got sent down to our G League team.
beats.dlg: SHABBY, LARGELY IGNORED.|HURT, SENT DOWN TO THE 905

beats.vo: Glaceon. It can drop its body temperature in an instant. Ice cold: a game-winning three in Orlando with half a second left.
beats.dlg: DROPS ITS TEMP AT WILL.|A 3 WITH 0.5 SECONDS LEFT!

beats.vo: Inteleon. Its ability is Sniper, and it picks out a foe's weak points. Forty point nine percent from three last season.
Infernape. Its fire never goes out, and it'll take on any opponent. Twenty-four points in a playoff overtime win over Cleveland.
beats.dlg: ITS FIRE NEVER GOES OUT.|24 IN A PLAYOFF OT WIN!

beats.vo: And the ace. Milotic. It's what that ignored Feebas evolves into, the most beautiful Pokemon of all. Fully evolved: eleven a night through ten games.
beats.dlg: WHAT FEEBAS BECOMES.|11.0 A NIGHT, 10 GAMES IN!

beats.vo: That's a party we'd take into any building. Which one would you swap in? Comment below.
beats.dlg: A PARTY WE'D TAKE INTO|ANY BUILDING. WHO'S IN?

facts.claim: Walter played college basketball for the Baylor Bears and was named Big 12 Freshman of the Year (2024); June 26, 2024 selected with the 19th overall pick (#19, pick 19) by Toronto; missed training camp with an AC joint sprain and was assigned several times to Raptors 905; March 4, 2025: game-winning three (3) with 0.5 seconds remaining in a 114-113 win at Orlando; May 1, 2026: playoff career-high 24 points in a 112-110 overtime (OT) win against Cleveland
